status: ACTIVE QUALITY BASELINE — LOOP 018 CORRECTS PHOTO DISTRIBUTION, ORGANIC NEWS BUBBLES AND CONTRAST-SAFE PLAYFUL PALETTE
business_objective: Create an informative, welcoming and visually distinctive website explaining La Bulle Bleue and APAiL, representing publicly reported activities without overpromising and helping visitors contact the association.
primary_user_intent: Understand who La Bulle Bleue and APAiL are, explore a small number of current editorial updates, learn how to adhere, then contact the association through clear and accessible routes.
critical_user_journeys: Accueil → Qui sommes-nous ? → Adhérer → contact APAiL
Accueil → Actualités → one dedicated article → return to the news overview or source Facebook page
Actualités → selected dated article → source page
Any page → Mentions légales in the footer
functional_requirements: Nine static HTML pages: home, who-we-are, news overview, three article details, membership, contact and legal notices
Five consistent primary-navigation links in the order Accueil, Qui sommes-nous ?, Actualités, Adhérer, Nous contacter
Mentions légales is reachable from the shared footer, not crowded into the primary navigation
The homepage has one illustrated sticky background and three scroll chapters; the illustration remains fixed while the text changes
Scroll transitions are progressive enhancement; content is visible without JavaScript, IntersectionObserver or motion
prefers-reduced-motion users never receive hidden homepage story content
The Actualités overview displays exactly three editorial cards; each has an illustration, date, short caption, concise summary and Voir plus link
Each news card opens its own full article page with image/illustration, date, editorial text and source reference
All article copy is traceable to exact dated posts in the user-provided Facebook extraction
The shared logo, palette, header and footer are consistent on all pages; the current news section is indicated on article pages
Membership CTA uses email; no fee, membership form, required document or renewal term is invented
Legal notices page clearly marks missing legal identity and hosting data as pending association confirmation
Repository quality workflow runs on pushes and pull requests to main using read-only contents permission; the workflow contains no deployment job.
Static validation runs tests/validate_site.py on a clean checkout.
JavaScript syntax and menu/story/reduced-motion regression run with Node.js.

A Playwright Chromium suite serves the site locally and tests all nine routes across 320/390/768/1024/1440 px, local images, mobile navigation, homepage story transitions, reduced-motion and no-JavaScript fallbacks, external requests and console errors.
Browser review screenshots are uploaded as a short-retention workflow artifact; no screenshots or results are claimed until the job has actually been observed.
content_requirements: Identify La Bulle Bleue as an APAiL initiative launched in 2021 and APAiL as created in 1995
Consolidate audience, activity examples, volunteers and historical solidarity information on Qui sommes-nous ?
Keep operational schedule/location source dates and confirmation caveats; do not present 2024 details as independently current
Feature exactly three news items dated 26 October, 17 October and 10 October 2026
Use concise editorial summaries, not fabricated first-person stories, testimonials or unreported outcomes
Label SVG story imagery as illustrations rather than photographs of the specific events
Keep Adhérer and Contact direct and email-led without personal-data collection
Mark unprovided legal name, registered-office address, publication responsible person and host details as unknown/pending confirmation

brand.direction: Joyful, playful, childlike and arts-led; bubble-like organic shapes replace rigid rectangles, informal handwritten-style headings and rounded body typography replace the restrained professional treatment, while the supplied blue logo remains recognisable.
brand.logo_status: Official transparent PNG supplied by the user at assets/logo final.png; integrated in all six page headers and footers in Loop 010.
brand.palette_status: The original blue logo palette remains the identity anchor. Loop 017 adds a clearly supplementary owner-requested palette of coral, lemon, mint, lilac and warm paper; these accents are design additions, not claims about an official published palette.

logo_derived_system.palette: Logo-derived cool blues with icy light surfaces; the former clay/ochre palette has been removed.
logo_derived_system.sampling_method: RGBA source 1052×1024; transparent pixels excluded; alpha-weighted 8-cluster colour analysis on a deterministic sample of 120,000 visible pixels. Reported shares are approximate visible-pixel cluster shares; each hex is the nearest actual source pixel to its cluster centre.

visual_requirements.palette: Use only the sampled logo blues plus documented pale near-white tints derived from the logo; no warm clay/ochre accents.
visual_requirements.homepage: The homepage remains light: five supplied drawings in the sticky story collage, three short story chapters and gathering.jpeg beside the closing DERRIÈRE LA BULLE/contact links. No assets/posts gallery or other activity photographs appear on the homepage.
visual_requirements.news: Three dated stories are presented as distinct, irregular bubble-shaped articles with inset curved illustrations and responsive stacked layout. A separate, undated gallery shows three community/group photographs; it explicitly states they are not tied to the dated stories.
visual_requirements.articles: A clean article template with date, headline, short deck, one labelled illustration, concise text, provenance note and return-to-news link.
visual_requirements.navigation: Five clear primary destinations. Mentions légales remains in the shared footer.
visual_requirements.cards: Avoid rigid rectangles. Use organic, uneven bubble-like silhouettes, soft dotted or hand-drawn outlines, pill controls, gentle rotations and generous readable spacing throughout all nine public pages.
visual_requirements.typography: Friendly handwritten-style headline fallback and rounded, readable body fallback; informal and fun rather than formal/professional. No remote font dependency.
visual_requirements.home_closing_photo: Place assets/gathering.jpeg prominently beside the DERRIÈRE LA BULLE/contact content at the end of the homepage. The owner supplied the image and verbally authorised its visible use on the website.
visual_requirements.photo_gallery: Display all eleven local photos from assets/posts in a playful organic gallery with descriptive alt text and short captions. The owner supplied the photographs and verbally authorised their website use.
visual_requirements.about_photos: Eight supplied activity photographs appear beside the activities content on Qui sommes-nous in a compact responsive gallery; descriptive French alt text and short captions identify the activity, not the people.
visual_requirements.photo_distribution: Distribute the eleven assets/posts photos away from the homepage: 8 activity photos on Qui sommes-nous, 3 group/outing photos in a separate undated strip on Actualités. Do not imply the three Actualités photos depict the three dated stories.
visual_requirements.colour_contrast: Use explicit deep navy/blue text on pale cream/pastel backgrounds and light text only on dark blue gradients. Page-intro has a pale background and must use dark text. Avoid low-contrast pale-blue title emphasis on pale surfaces; keep the solidarity note on a pale surface with dark text.
visual_requirements.news_card_shape: Article cards must visibly read as organic bubbles/blobs, not merely rounded rectangles. Use asymmetrical shapes, varied card contour and inset organic image frames with mobile stacking.

motion.implementation: Progressive IntersectionObserver enhancement toggles the active homepage story panel; no animation or hidden content is required for comprehension.
motion.fallback: All three text chapters are visible by default. Only when IntersectionObserver is supported and prefers-reduced-motion is false does the page add an enhancement class and transition the active chapter.

technical.architecture: Static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript
technical.image_hosting: Local repository assets under assets/; no remote image host or third-party image request.

quality_checks.browser: Playwright Python 1.57.0 with Chromium; tests are tooling-only and do not add a runtime website dependency.
quality_checks.deployment: No deploy job, no Vercel credentials and no production mutation.

accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA; foundation includes semantics, alt text, dimensions, keyboard navigation, reduced-motion fallback and progressive reveal. Manual screen-reader testing remains outstanding.
success_criteria: The owner-authorised gathering.jpeg is placed beside the closing homepage contact content.
The homepage contains no assets/posts photos or home photo album; gathering.jpeg remains the one documentary photo beside the closing contact section.
All eleven assets/posts photos are displayed on the two relevant secondary pages: eight activities on Qui sommes-nous and three undated community images on Actualités.
The three dated Actualités cards have clear organic blob silhouettes and remain responsive.
Pastel page headers and solidarity panel use dark readable text; dark panels use light text; headline emphasis has adequate contrast.
business_outcome_hypotheses: Specific activity stories may help families understand the initiative
A richer editorial visual system may feel more approachable
Outcomes require visitor feedback/measurement and are not proven by implementation
